captureYearMeaning: Official source archive is the 2017 photography mesh; not a live image or the 2025 server modification date.
verticalDatum: EGM96 orthometric height, as explicitly declared by the downloaded metadata.xml. The general Helsinki website also describes N2000; this conversion follows the actual archive metadata.
conversion: Lossless byte-identical POSITION/TEXCOORD vertex deduplication with standard glTF indices; original ordered triangles, root transforms and bounds retained. Original JPEG bytes retained; Melbourne restores the original archive JPEG including 8K where available. No quantization, decimation, texture resampling or recompression. Original model directory remains unchanged.
photographHashMeaning: photograph.originalSHA256 identifies the archive JPEG; originalPhotographSHA256 identifies the JPEG embedded in the input B3DM. PC photograph.sha256 identifies the unchanged archive JPEG used for display.
